transcript.text: I think we were some of the best at
training sales because of this. On
someone's first day, we'd say, "Hey,
John, I'm going to have you read through
this script. I'm probably going to
interrupt you 30 or 40 times, and if I
do that, it means we're doing a good
job. You're going to say one sentence,
and I'll be like, 'Stop. Say it like
this. Try it again. Okay. Try it like
this. Say it again. Okay, great. Again.
Great. Again. Awesome. Next sentence.'"
You basically work them through the
script so that they say it exactly the
way they need to. And so, we want many
interruptions, and it's about speed of
feedback. You have to do 50, 60 feedback
loops in one conversation, and you do
that conversation two times a day,
and they get real good real fast.
